sections.title: Risk Factors
sections.excerpt: RISK FACTORS An investment in our Series D Preferred Stock involves various risks, including those described below and in the accompanying base prospectus and the risks set forth in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 under Item 1A, “Risk Factors,” which are incorporated by reference in this prospectus supplement. You should carefully consider these risk factors, together with all of the information contained in or incorporated, or deemed to be incorporated, by reference in this prospectus supplement and the accompanying base prospectus, in determining whether to purchase our Series D Preferred Stock. Risks Related to the Series D Preferred Stock and this Offering The Series D Preferred Stock ranks junior to all of our indebtedness and other liabilities and is effectively junior to all indebtedness and other liabilities of our subsidiaries.
